tasks.goal: All project.ts detail resource requests use the path project ID as explicit request context.
input_facts: http.ts prioritizes explicit projectContext over the stored global project ID.
JwtAuthenticationFilter rejects a /api/project/{id} path whose header differs from id.
Release-calendar and announcement calls in project.ts already demonstrate withProjectContext(id).
invariants: Do not change request paths, methods, payloads, return types, global selector state, or server-side validation.
interface_contracts: Every /api/project/${id} request emits X-Project-Id=id via withProjectContext(id).
Query parameter requests preserve existing params while adding explicit context.
non_goals: Changing http.ts, project-context store, ProjectView route behavior, server code, or database.
action_bounds: Modify only Axios configuration arguments in project.ts and run targeted static/build sensors.
acceptance_checks: Enumeration confirms every id-scoped project.ts request includes withProjectContext(id).
evidence_required: Any unexpected consumer or type disturbance
tasks.rollback: Revert only the project.ts configuration additions from this task.
stop_conditions: A required call cannot take an Axios configuration without a contract change.
escalation_conditions: Correctness requires changing http.ts, the store, router, backend, or a path/payload contract.

tasks.goal: All project attachment and category requests use the path project ID as explicit request context.
input_facts: Project attachment paths are under /api/project/{projectId} and receive the same security path guard.
Existing upload requests carry multipart headers and a 60-second timeout that must be preserved.
invariants: Do not change non-project attachment endpoints, multipart headers, upload timeout, query parameters, global selector state, or backend behavior.
interface_contracts: Every project attachment/category call emits X-Project-Id=projectId via withProjectContext(projectId).
Params, multipart headers, and timeout are merged rather than replaced.
non_goals: Changing attachment service contracts, storage behavior, http.ts, store, backend, or database.
action_bounds: Modify only project-scoped Axios configuration arguments in attachments.ts and run targeted static/build sensors.
acceptance_checks: Enumeration confirms list, category, upload, classification, preview, download, and delete project calls include withProjectContext(projectId).
evidence_required: Confirmation that upload options remain present
tasks.rollback: Revert only the attachments.ts configuration additions from this task.
stop_conditions: Configuration merge would remove an existing upload header, timeout, or parameter.
escalation_conditions: A project attachment request needs a backend or common HTTP client change.

tasks.goal: Independently observe that global project A and detail route project B remain isolated at runtime.
input_facts: The runtime filter rejects mismatched path/header requests.
ProjectView source only selects a global project on creation, not when opening an existing route.
invariants: Do not alter product code while observing; record environmental limits rather than fabricating runtime evidence.
interface_contracts: With selector A and route B, checked requests must use URL B and header B while stored selector remains A.
non_goals: Creating or changing project data solely to force a test, relaxing authorization, or touching unrelated dirty changes.
action_bounds: Use local browser, local service probes, source/static checks, and approved evidence files only.
acceptance_checks: When two projects are available, browser network/local storage samples show A/B isolation for basic data, a plan operation, and attachment read or operation.
evidence_required: Browser route, stored selector, request URL/header, response and console observations
tasks.rollback: No product changes occur in T3; revert T1/T2 if observation finds a regression.
stop_conditions: Local services are unavailable or only one accessible project prevents A/B observation.
escalation_conditions: Header B still fails the server path guard, or any validated request mutates selector A to B.
